tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Get an overview of cloverbase.com: what the site is about and its key pages with URLs. Returns JSON.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List the most recent published articles on cloverbase.com, newest first, optionally filtered by category. Returns title, date, category, excerpt, and URL as JSON.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-50, default 10).

category.description: Optional category name to filter by (case-insensitive).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search published articles on cloverbase.com by keyword across title, category, tags, and excerpt. Returns the best matches as JSON with URLs.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Fill in the email newsletter signup form. The user must review the email address and click the button to confirm the subscription.
